'''Lordopus''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Fishopus]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The king is crowned, and the chaotic tentacles of the past are now the throne of the sovereign. With just one thought, Lordopus can command the ebb and flow of all the seas."

Lordopus is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
